Subject: POC: Prompt set & eval plan - Acme Health

Hi Lena — great speaking today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the POC scope and data we'll need from your side.

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood's ability to reliably surface clinically-relevant suggestions for provider notes with low hallucination and acceptable latency at scale.

Success criteria (suggested):
- Accuracy: >= 88% match to annotated ground truth on critical extraction fields (diagnosis, medication, dosage).
- Hallucination rate: < 3% on test prompts (as measured by our hallucination detector).
- Latency: median response < 220ms (95th < 400ms) for single-request inference in your region.
- Cost: projected cost-per-1k tokens within 20% of current benchmark.

Evaluation plan / data we need from you:
1) Prompt set: 200-500 representative prompts (patient scenarios/provider notes) in CSV format. Use the attached prompt_set_template.csv — columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_output (if available), sensitivity_label (PHI/NoPHI).
2) Logs (optional): Anonymized example logs of historical prompts/responses to help us tune the evaluation harness (if you can provide, please remove direct PHI or mark rows as PHI).
3) Acceptance tests: a short set (~50) of high-priority prompts you want us to monitor for regressions.

Security / upload: We can provide a presigned S3 upload and a secure SharePoint link. If any prompts contain PHI, we'll follow your redaction guidance and use customer-managed KMS.

Timeline (proposed):
- 3/18: Receive prompt set + sample logs from Acme Health
- 3/19-3/25: Build eval harness, run baseline tests, and share interim results
- 3/26: Sync demo + decision meeting (internal stakeholders + Acme)

Ownership / next steps:
- Action: Lena to provide prompt_set.csv and any logs by 3/18 (owner: Acme).
- Action: Marissa to provision S3 upload and confirm redaction process by 3/13 (owner: Redwood).
- Action: Rafael to set up eval dashboard and monitoring (owner: Rafael).

I've attached a prompt template to make upload straightforward. If the dates above don't work on your side, suggest alternatives and we'll adjust.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

4) Mutual Action Plan: I've drafted a short M.A.P. and uploaded to our shared drive — link below. It includes the timeline we've discussed and the decision gating criteria for go/no-go after week 1. Please confirm acceptance or propose edits by 3/18.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/poc/acme_health/plan

- Rafael: presigned S3 link + upload instructions for Tom (by 3/17)

We'll treat any uploaded data as PII/PHI and follow the agreed controls. Let me know if you want a short call with Rafael/Tom to walk through the upload.
